summary: Second-pass regression: cookie-only auth, CORS, and Playwright E2E all pass. 15/15 backend pytest, curl verified cookie flow, Playwright verified login->landing->map->level->logout with no ek_token in localStorage.

issues: Review request mentions data-testids 'cover-card', 'index-list', 'ek-table', 'ref-list' but Landing.jsx uses <article id='s1'..'s10'> and other testids (dossier-carousel, carousel-caption, landing-page). Content renders correctly but the exact testids listed in the review are absent. Consider adding them to align with the docs/tests.

action_items: Optional: add data-testid='cover-card', 'index-list', 'ek-table', 'ref-list' on Landing.jsx sections to match documented test hooks.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext removal of localStorage token verified — window.localStorage.getItem('ek_token') is null after login (good XSS mitigation).
Backend cookie set with HttpOnly; Max-Age=86400; SameSite=lax — appropriate because FE and BE share same origin via ingress proxy.
CORS_ORIGINS now explicit origin; preflight OPTIONS returns 204; compatible with allow_credentials=True.
Logout properly deletes cookie (Set-Cookie access_token=""; Max-Age=0) and subsequent /api/auth/me returns 401.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cookie-based auth confirmed end-to-end. Backend 15/15 pytest green. E2E Playwright: login->landing (URL confirmed), /map shows 7 nodes, session survives reload, level 1 (Alphabet PairMatch) opens correctly, nav-logout redirects to /login and /api/auth/me returns 401. localStorage.ek_token is null as expected. Note: Landing.jsx does NOT have the specific data-testids named in the review request (cover-card/index-list/ek-table/ref-list); content renders under article#s1..s10 and testids dossier-carousel/carousel-caption/landing-page. Not a functional bug.
